g.text: MarieRank4Convo6 begins.
Check boolean LyonIndifference1
Drifter ? Do you have a moment ? I must speak with you about Lyon...
true
Chat ends.
false
Check boolean DrifterLyon
He's an adult. He can decide when he wants to talk.
true
false
My heart is breaking to see him going through this pain. I don't know how to help him.
true
[จบ]
true
false
I don't know how to help him.
false
When you were trapped in this world of your making, caught in an endless cycle of death, did you have help to escape ?
Oui, and it is painful to watch him suffer... Especially now knowing how you have made room in your heart for him.
Chat ends.
It is a hard thing, to predict where the borders may be with him. They often shift from day to day.
None of their help would have been worth anything if I didn't want to be helped.
I did, from friends.
I have seen him struggle with the agonies the gods have heaped upon his shoulders. I have known when to be silent at his side, or when to be the proverbial wall upon which he may pound his fists.
I don't think Lyon wants my help.
I'm trying to be here for him, but he's not listening.
Mais ça ? This ? This place, the words of the devil, the uncertainty that le Cardinal has caused... This has brought him pain from which I pray he can return.
Then I suppose... there is nothing left to do but be patient, non ?
Nor to myself, which is why I have come to discuss this with you. I have always been able to console him -
So you admit that Entrati has hurt Lyon? And how does this sit with you?
I feel like he's teetering on the brink. How do I help pull him back?
Merci. I am sorry to waste your time.
I find myself taken aback at his rage, his désespoir... he shuns my company in a way that he never has before.
Pas bien... But how am I meant to choose between my love for my brother and my adoration for le Cardinal ? How must I choose between my famille ?
I do not know, which is why I have come to discuss this with you. I have always been able to console him -
Chat ends.
What has troubled him so ? Do you know the cause ?
You don't have to choose, Marie. People can be complicated in the way they exist in our lives.
I would choose the family who is still here. Not the one who left you.
I'm sure Entrati didn't want to cause Lyon this kind of pain.
เจ้าสามารถเลือกครอบครัวใหม่ได้ เช่นข้า และคนรอบข้างที่คอยห่วงใย โดยไม่ต้องมี Entrati
Evaluate expressions
That's the problem with people like Entrati. They're not just forces for "Good" or "Bad." They're a mix.
Let us keep this talk of le Cardinal away from this conversation, oui ? I am concerned for the brother of my soul.
I do not think he did either, but the fact of it remains, oui ? But I appreciate your sentiment. Cela dit...
Update boolean DrifterMarie
Lyon is trying to come to terms with the fact that the Indifference isn't a real god.
DrifterFaithNoMITW
I don't think it's just one thing that's causing it. I think it's being caught between a great many things.
DrifterFaithNoMITW
LyonRell3
LyonRoathe3
LyonEntrati3
LyonRell1
Lyon was hearing the voice of one of the Tenno, a kid named Rell. Rell... died. I don't think he's coping well with this.
LyonRell3
He has Roathe whispering lies to him about the Man in the Wall.
LyonRoathe3
I don't imagine having Entrati whispering to him that the voices of his gods are actually the voices from the Void helped.
LyonEntrati3
I honestly don't, no.
false
Let us keep this talk of le Cardinal away from this conversation, oui ? I am concerned for the brother of my soul. But... I know what you say is... more and more becoming the clear truth.
อย่าคิดว่าฉันไม่เห็นสิ่งที่คุณทำ ที่แอบเข้าไปก่อนนะหมาป่า
And you have been no help in these matters, if you talk to him in such a way. Even if one's words are truth, one must be careful how they are delivered.
Oui, he has been a shelter in the storm for so many... and now he is caught in one himself.
I have heard him speak that name, Rell - and it breaks my heart to know of the boy's fate.
That devil has caused more woe in his long life than so many ! But I do not think it is the only cause of his strife, non ?
S'il te plaît, no more talk of le Cardinal. I do not deny that his words add to Lyon's strife, but it cannot be the only cause.
Then I suppose... all we can do is be patient and hope that we discover what troubles him.
Update boolean MarieEntrati4a
Surgery is not best performed with an axe. This is not the Brittanic Navy.
Torn from all sides, and not knowing which way to go...
But I do not think it is the only cause of his strife ? Lyon follows the path of Lua. La mort est une compagne qui marche à ses côtés
It has aided his uncertainty... But to put that much value into the words of a devil ? My Lyon knows better than that. I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.
Update boolean MarieEntrati4b
+15 Chemistry
Non, I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.
We have to be his shelter, then. A place he knows won't hurt him.
We need to show him the way back to safety, then. Be the light in the darkness.
I guess then... we need to show him the way back to safety, then. Be the light in the darkness.
I guess then... we just have to be his shelter. A place he knows won't hurt him.
He did not place enough weight in le Cardinal's words to let it pitch him into such darkness. I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.
Merci. I know you are trying your best. And for this, I am grateful.
+10 Chemistry
How do you aid someone who cannot hear your call, cannot see your light ? Non, Lua has shrouded him in this darkness.
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
Oui, I suppose you are right. We must be those that he can turn to, when all else fails him.
I do not think even the light of Sol could pierce the veil.
Where his faith may be infirm, we must be the ground beneath his feet.
If all the unseen voices have turned from welcome fantômes to démons in the shadows that plague him -
We must make ourselves all the more real, non ?
I'll keep trying.
I just hope this doesn't tear him apart.
+10 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
That is all we can do, in the end.
Oui... as do I. But all we can do is stand beside him and pray, non ?
Try. And pray.
And hope it is not too late.
Merci... I must go. I am sorry if this conversation was not of much use. I fret when I cannot act.
I'm the same way. But sometimes, action is the wrong choice.
He'll be all right. I'm sure of it.
I pray you are correct. I do not know what I would do without him.
Chat ends.
